verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows an official SDK. The only integration mention is a future-tense line about a '2FAS API' for services ('you'll be able to integrate'), and 2FAS's own llms.txt declares 'Public API: None', with every OpenAPI path probe returning 404. Open-source GitHub repositories for the apps and extensions are source code, not a buildable SDK, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
